app_fee.value: Each application needs a nonrefundable $35 fee, paid again for each program applied to.
app_fee.quote: You are required to submit your online application and nonrefundable $35 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are only for McNair Scholars, U.S. Armed Forces and Veterans, and Native American applicants; no international waiver is stated.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fees are waived for McNair Scholars, U.S. Armed Forces and Veterans, and Native American applicants.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4 on the new scale for tests taken from January 21, 2026; 71 for older tests.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: 4 (internet based); 71 on tests taken prior to January 21, 2026

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list and no medium-of-instruction exemption is stated, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Countries Exempt from the English Proficiency Examination Requirement

also.quote: Been raised in a recognized country where English is the only official language

notes: Admissions page still lists TOEFL 71 and TOEFL Duolingo 105; the English page gives the new TOEFL scale. Graduate teaching assistants need higher minimums (TOEFL 100, IELTS 7, Duolingo 125 per ECE catalog; GTA minimums in the University Catalog).
